label: Skirts
note: Authored, never generated. A skirt occupies the bottom slot but, unlike trousers, its selling properties are length, volume and how it moves — so it gets a movement shot and a seated shot rather than a walking shot. The top is tucked so the waistband and exact rise stay visible.
preserve_fields: the fabric colour, pattern scale and placement
the waistband height, width and how it sits
the length and exactly where the hem falls on the leg
the volume and silhouette — pleats, gathers, flare or straight fall
the closure — zip, buttons or tie — and its placement
the hem finish and any slit, vent or trim

ref_descriptions.front: the front of a skirt photographed flat on a plain surface
ref_descriptions.back: the BACK of the same skirt photographed flat
ref_descriptions.detail: a macro of the same skirt's fabric, waistband and closure

blocks.keep_onmodel: Keep the SAME {{campaign.pronoun.noun}} (identical face, hair, skin tone and build), the SAME {{product.short_name}} with its fabric, pattern, waistband, volume and length unchanged, the SAME {{wardrobe_short}}, and the SAME {{campaign.set_short}} and {{campaign.light_short}}.
blocks.keep_lower: Keep the SAME {{product.short_name}} with its fabric, waistband and length unchanged, the SAME {{wardrobe_short}}, and the SAME {{campaign.set_short}} and {{campaign.light_short}}.
blocks.must_preserve: MUST PRESERVE EXACTLY from the references, unchanged: {{product.garment}}; and {{preserve_fields}}. Do not lengthen or shorten the hem, and do not add or remove volume. Do not add any extra text, logo or graphic anywhere on the garment.
blocks.tail: {{campaign.grade}}, sharp focus, no motion blur, no extra text or logos.
blocks.no_person: ABSOLUTELY NO human presence: no skin, no legs, no waist, no hands, no body underneath the fabric. Nothing but cloth.
blocks.flatlay_setup: flat-lay product photography, no person and no mannequin anywhere in the frame. The {{category.garment_noun_short}} is laid flat on {{campaign.flatlay_surface}} and photographed from directly above
